examples.text: Umgekehrt ist aber nicht jeder stationäre Prozeß auch ergodisch. Damit er auch ergodisch ist, muß jede Realisierung des stochastischen Prozesses repräsentativ sein für das ganze Ensemble.
examples.translation: Conversely, not every stationary process is also ergodic. In order to be ergodic, each realization of the stochastic process must be representative for the whole ensemble.
examples.english: Conversely, not every stationary process is also ergodic. In order to be ergodic, each realization of the stochastic process must be representative for the whole ensemble.
